name: 時尚雜誌封面 (Magazine Cover)
new_prompt:
**Subject:** High fashion model posing in elegant dress
**Title:** "SOLENNE"
**Art Styles & Tech:** Magazine Layout, High Fashion, Studio Lighting, Typography, Elegant, Glossy
**Texture:** on glossy plastic texture

--- LAYOUT SECTIONS ---
[Section 1]
* Visual: Skyline (Top Strip) | Param: Top edge text, small sans-serif, uppercase | Text: 'SPECIAL EDITION' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Light]) | Text: 'THE SUMMER ISSUE' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Medium])
[Section 2]
* Visual: Masthead (Title) | Param: Top center, massive bold serif font, overlaying model head slightly, gold or white color | Text: 'SOLENNE' written in massive heavy typography (Font: Serif [ExtraBold])
[Section 3]
* Visual: Tagline | Param: Small text immediately below masthead, centered | Text: 'FASHION & LIFESTYLE' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Regular])
[Section 4]
* Visual: Model Portrait | Param: Center, medium shot, direct eye contact, elegant pose, studio gray background, high fashion makeup
[Section 5]
* Visual: Main Headline | Param: Bottom center, massive bold display font, high contrast color | Text: 'NEW LOOK' written in massive heavy typography (Font: Bold Display [Heavy])
[Section 6]
* Visual: Sub-headline | Param: Below main headline, smaller serif font | Text: 'Exclusive Interview with the Star' written in prominent semi-bold font (Font: Serif [Medium])
[Section 7]
* Visual: Cover Lines (Left) | Param: Left side list, aligned left, varied font weights | Text: '100+ Summer Trends' written in clear body text (Font: Sans-serif [Bold]) | Text: 'Beauty Secrets Revealed' written in clear body text (Font: Sans-serif [Light])
[Section 8]
* Visual: Cover Lines (Right) | Param: Right side list, aligned right, varied font weights | Text: 'Travel: Paris Guide' written in clear body text (Font: Sans-serif [Bold]) | Text: 'Healthy Living' written in clear body text (Font: Sans-serif [Light])
[Section 9]
* Visual: Puff / Badge | Param: Circular badge element, bright color, containing text | Text: 'WIN!' written in prominent semi-bold font (Font: Bold Display [Black]) | Text: 'Luxury Trip' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Bold])
[Section 10]
* Visual: Footer Info | Param: Bottom edge, tiny text, spacing | Text: 'WWW.VOGUE.COM' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Regular]) | Text: 'SEPTEMBER 2025' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Regular])
[Section 11]
* Visual: Barcode & Price | Param: Bottom right corner, realistic barcode box | Text: '$5.99' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Monospace [Regular])
[Section 12]
* Visual: Model Credit | Param: Bottom left or vertical along edge, tiny text | Text: 'Photo by Annie Leibovitz' written in tiny minimalist text (Font: Sans-serif [Light])

--- PARAMETERS ---
**Text Language:** Use Traditional Chinese for text rendered in the image.
**Quality:** sharp focus, high quality, detailed, professional
aspect ratio 3:4 4k resolution
